```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}

lower_bound_T <- function(k_vals, V_vals, ntf = 1500, p_suc = 1) {
  sparsity_levels <- c(0.01, 0.05, seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1))
  results <- list()
  
  for (V in V_vals) {
    N <- ntf * (V - 1)  # allowed number of directed edges
    for (k in k_vals) {
      df <- data.frame(
        sparsity = sparsity_levels,
        E = round(sparsity_levels * N),
        T_bound = NA,
        k = k,
        V = V
      )
      
      df$T_bound <- map2_dbl(df$E, N, function(E, N_total) {
        if (E == 0 || E >= N_total) {
          return(NA)
        } else {
          log_binom <- lgamma(N_total + 1) - lgamma(E + 1) - lgamma(N_total - E + 1)
          return(ceiling(log_binom / log(2) / (V - k)))
        }
      })
      results[[paste0("V", V, "_k", k)]] <- df
    }
  }
  
  final_df <- bind_rows(results, .id = "setting")
  print(final_df)
  
  ggplot(final_df, aes(x = sparsity, y = T_bound, color = setting)) +
    geom_line(size = 0.5) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "Information-Theoretic Lower Bound on Number of Experiments (T)",
      x = "Sparsity (|E| / N)",
      y = "Lower Bound on T",
      color = "Setting (V & k)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
}

```


```{r}
lower_bound_T(k_vals = c(1, 2, 4,8), V_vals = c(1500))
```
```{r}
plot_success_prob <- function(k_vals, V_vals, ntf = 1500, sparsity = 0.05, T_range = 100:300) {
  results <- list()

  for (V in V_vals) {
    N <- ntf * (V - 1)
    for (k in k_vals) {
      E <- round(sparsity * N)  # fixed sparsity level
      log2_binom <- (lgamma(N + 1) - lgamma(E + 1) - lgamma(N - E + 1)) / log(2)
      
      df <- data.frame(
        T = T_range,
        log2_binom = log2_binom,
        log2_p_suc = T_range * (V - k) - log2_binom,
        k = k,
        V = V
      )
      df$p_suc <- pmin(1, 2^df$log2_p_suc)  # safe exponentiation, capped at 1
      results[[paste0("V", V, "_k", k)]] <- df
    }
  }

  final_df <- bind_rows(results, .id = "setting")
  print(final_df)

  ggplot(final_df, aes(x = T, y = p_suc, color = setting)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.1) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Success Probability vs Number of Experiments (Sparsity = ", sparsity, ")"),
      x = "Number of Experiments T",
      y = "Upper Bound on Success Probability",
      color = "Setting (V & k)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    ylim(0, 1.05) +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
}

```


```{r}
plot_success_prob(k_val1s = c(1, 2, 4,8), V_vals = c(1500), sparsity = 0.05, T_range = 300:500)
```

lower_bound_T(k_vals = c(8), V_vals = c(250),ntf = 250)

```{r}
calculate_T_bound <- function(E, N_TF, N_non_TF, V,k, allow_self_regulation = FALSE) {
  N_total <- N_TF * (N_TF + N_non_TF)
  if (!allow_self_regulation) {
    N_total <- N_total - N_TF
  }
  
  if (E == 0 || E >= N_total) {
    return(NA)
  }
  
  log_binom <- lgamma(N_total + 1) - lgamma(E + 1) - lgamma(N_total - E + 1)
  T_bound <- ceiling(log_binom / log(2) / (V - k))
  
  return(T_bound)
}
```
